threads.body: [Performance] This path now filters the merged attributes a second time after the duration metric already filtered them above. For receive operations that record both stable metrics and have a template/temporary/anonymous destination, each `filterAttributes` call rebuilds `Attributes`, doubling the hot-path allocation compared with the previous shared `filteredAttributes`. Please preserve one filtered instance for both recordings (for example, via an internal recorder entry point that accepts already-filtered attributes).

replies.body: The messaging refactor that introduced the duplicate filtering has been removed from this PR. The current diff no longer changes `MessagingConsumerMetrics`.

threads.body: [General] This new public messaging recorder and the related metric refactor are unrelated to the scoped-thread-suppression change stated in the title and description. Please split this feature into a separate PR or update the PR metadata to describe the added public API and messaging metric behavior so it can be reviewed and surfaced accurately.

replies.body: The unrelated messaging recorder and metric changes have been removed from this PR. The current diff and PR metadata are now scoped to thread suppression.
